requirements.text: - Strong software engineering fundamentals, with experience in multiple general-purpose programming languages including Python and Java.
- 3+ years of industry experience in software engineering.
- Deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), DevOps practices and tools, continuous integration (CI), and infrastructure as code (IaC).
- Experience building and deploying data pipelines using distributed frameworks such as Spark, Hadoop, or Airflow.
- A “roll up your sleeves” attitude: you take ownership of problems, relentlessly drill down to root causes, and fix issues at the source, learning new tools and technologies on the fly.

- Ability to efficiently drive complex projects to completion while working collaboratively across multiple teams, including DevOps, data and ontology engineering, QA, and application software engineering.
- Will be required to go onsite at the Redwood City office.
- Desire to learn the ins and outs of working with biomedical data in research and clinical applications. Prior experience with life sciences is a plus, but not required.
